title: 第40章 陛下，君无戏言啊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 闻言，原本不掺和的一群武将，当时就怒了。“啥玩意儿，老子都准备好了？你们现在说不打了？”“滚你们大爷的，军队都出发了，将领都选好了，你们现在说不打？开什么玩笑！”“……”一群武将顿时不乐意了，暴跳如雷。然而，却没有人理他们。一群粗鄙武夫，理他们作甚？唐敬直接无视一群武将，站出来冲着炎文帝拱手道：“陛下，陛下之前说了，只要能写出一篇劝谏诗，便有得谈。”“陛下，君无戏言啊！”炎文帝看着这一幕，脸色阴沉至极。他刚才的确是这个意思，以为没人能写出比《满江红》更好的诗词，却没想到唐画写出来了。这让他一时间进退两难！不打？军队都派出去了，粮草已经在筹集了，圣旨也下达了。这时候说不打？那群武将会怎么想？打！这是他之前所说的话，难道要他一个皇帝自食其言？陈貂寺很清楚炎文帝此时的处境，低声提醒道：“陛下，宁千户将人带来了。”炎文帝一怔，心头顿时就有数了。“谈，可以谈，不过在谈之前，朕让你们先见一个人。”炎文帝大喝一声，道：“来人，把人带上来。”宁川便拎着一个血肉模糊的男人进了大殿。见到锦衣卫带着一个血肉模糊的人进来，一众文官心头顿时一突，心头有了一丝不好的预感。有锦衣卫掺和的事，绝对不是什么好事！“臣宁川，参见陛下。”宁川将吴勇丢在地上，跪地行礼道：“人已带到，请陛下定夺。”闻言，一众大臣顿时一头雾水，炎文帝看向吴勇冷然道：“你是何人？来大炎所为何事，从实招来！”吴勇挣扎着从地上爬起来，冷冷地盯着炎文帝：“我乃是朔利可汗帐下谍者，吴勇，专门负责对大炎的谍情报收集。”“哈哈，一群愚蠢的蠢猪，等着吧！你们的末日就要到了。”“朔利可汗即将率领三十万铁骑，会同东虞三十万大军一起，将大炎瓜分殆尽，哈哈哈……”闻言，所有人顿时脸色大变，整个大殿当场也喧嚣起来。“什么？北狄和东虞联手了？”“不可能，这绝对不可能，东虞刚刚与我大炎签订盟约，他们怎敢背刺我大炎。”“放肆，你是何人，竟敢在此胡言乱语？”“说，谁指使你干的？”“……”一众大臣顿时怒火中烧，冲着吴勇怒斥。此时此刻，他们很多人都认为这是皇帝的一出戏，为了杜绝和谈，而自导自演的一出好戏。东虞和北狄刚刚签订了互不侵犯盟约，签订盟约的丞相还没回大炎，东虞就对北狄出手了？这可能吗？这绝对不可能！“呵，哈哈哈……哈哈哈……”吴勇手脚都戴着脚铐手铐，浑身鲜血淋漓，但听到群臣的怒斥，笑得那是一个疯狂，涕泪横流。笑声几乎瞬间压过了大殿的声讨。“狗贼，你笑什么？”有人忍不住怒斥。“我笑什么？我笑你们这群狗贼啊！”吴勇努力直起腰杆，盯着坐在主位上的炎文帝：“怎么样？皇帝，陛下，感觉到悲哀吗？感觉到羞耻吗？”“这就是你的大臣，这就是你的国之栋梁！”“文不思治，武不思战，你觉得大炎还有救吗？”“哈哈……你们只能等着我北狄大军南下，再一次遭遇屠戮，杀得干干净净……”吴勇手猛地一挥，手中铁链直接被甩飞，吓得满朝大臣连连惊慌后退。炎文帝面无表情，却觉得自己的脸已经被打肿了。一众大臣被这么羞辱，顿时怒火中烧，唐敬直接指着吴勇怒斥：“看你也是大炎人，却成了北狄人的狗，叛徒，你也有脸在这里叫嚣？”“我不是！”吴勇怒斥。“我不是大炎人，在十五年前，我就已经不是大炎人了。”吴勇手扫过全场，恨意滔天：“大炎人，呵呵，哈哈，老子这辈子最恨的就是这三个字。”“你们知道这些年，我们在北狄是怎么过来的吗？”“我们的女人，我们的女儿，每天每夜都遭受北狄人的凌辱。”“我们的孩子刚刚出生……对，就是刚看到这个世界的第一眼，等待他们的，是一块烧得通红的烙铁。”“通红的烙铁在他们粉嫩的屁股上，嗤的一声，烧焦的肉味在鼻息下蔓延，然后就是孩子哇哇的哭声。”“此后余生，他们的身份只有一个——奴隶！”“而这一切，全都是因为你们！”“若非你们这群所谓的朝中栋梁贪权卖国、贪生怕死，我等无数百姓，又怎会遭此厄运！”“是你们，眼睁睁你们的子民被北狄掳走而无动于衷！”“敢问一句，谁才是狗贼？！啊？！”“哈哈哈哈……”吴勇指着满朝文武，仰天大笑。眼泪混合血液落下，以至于他整张脸青白交替，狰狞至极，极为恐怖。一群文臣想到吴勇所说的画面，顿时都头皮发麻。而狄苍等一众武将，却都攥紧拳头，只觉得脸上火辣辣的，羞愧地低下了头。炎文帝平静看着发狂的吴勇，心头就像是被刀扎一样。“大炎人？呵，我呸！”“我是叛徒，我不可饶恕，可我……依旧以你们为耻！”“大炎有你们，必亡！哈哈哈……”吴勇状若疯狂地看向炎文帝，道：“该说的，我已经说了，高高在上的皇帝陛下，要杀要剐，尽管来！”“我若皱一下眉头，便对不起被折辱死去的万千同胞！”炎文帝看着站在大殿上的吴勇，一时间竟然无言以对。叛国，罪该当诛。卖国，罪该当剐。可是，他们曾经也曾忠君爱国……谁，曾爱过他们？炎文帝的目光落在满殿大臣的身上，只觉得此时的他们，格外的刺眼。忠君爱国！呵，不知民间疾苦，不懂百姓所求，不过口号罢了！“宁川，带他下去吧！”炎文帝没有下令杀吴勇，他是皇帝，主宰一切，可他没这个脸。吴勇依旧大笑，被宁川拖下去了，但他依旧大笑，但出大殿大门的时候，他仰头喷出一口鲜血，连同咬断的舌头也喷了出去。他咬舌自尽了！活到现在，他就是想站在这大殿上，说点自己想说的话而已。他活着，他在北狄的家人，就得死。炎文帝猛地站了起来，只见那个男人已经缓缓往地下跪了下去，但仰着头瞪着眼睛看着北方……如果不被唐逸发现身份，他要做的，就是将大炎数十万大军送进北狄和东虞的包围圈，灭掉大炎的有生力量。他不后悔！他只是恨！恨这个国家，将他们给遗忘了。他们不是猪羊。他们，是人！！！最后，吴勇的脑袋缓缓垂下，只有含糊不清的声音传来：“呵呵噜噜噜……”那是他的遗言，却没人听清他说的是什么。
content_en: Hearing this, a group of generals who had not interfered at first became angry."What the hell, I'm ready? Are you saying you won't fight now?" "Get out of here, uncle, the army has set off and the generals have been selected, and you're saying you won't fight now? What a joke!" "..." A group of military generals suddenly became unhappy and became furious.However, no one paid attention to them.A bunch of vulgar warriors, what should I do with them?Tang Jing ignored a group of military generals, stood up and raised his hands to Emperor Yanwen and said: "Your Majesty, Your Majesty said before that as long as he can write a remonstrative poem, we can have a discussion." "Your Majesty, you have nothing to say!" Emperor Yanwen looked at this scene with a gloomy face.He really meant this just now, thinking that no one could write a better poem than "Man Jiang Hong", but he didn't expect that Tang Hua could write it.This put him in a dilemma for a while!Not fighting?The troops have been sent out, food and grass have been collected, and the imperial edict has been issued.Are you saying you won’t fight now?What do those generals think?beat!This is what he said before. Do you want him, an emperor, to go back on his words?Chen Diaosi was very aware of Emperor Yanwen's situation at this time, and reminded him in a low voice: "Your Majesty, Ning Qianhu has brought people here." Emperor Yanwen was startled, and his mind suddenly became clear."We can talk, but before we talk, I want you to meet someone first." Emperor Yanwen shouted and said, "Come here, bring this person up." Ning Chuan then carried a bloody man into the hall.Seeing Jin Yiwei coming in with a bloody man, all the civil servants suddenly felt a sudden rush in their hearts, and they had a bad premonition in their hearts.It's definitely not a good thing for Jin Yiwei to get involved!"Your Majesty, Ning Chuan." Ning Chuan threw Wu Yong to the ground, knelt down and saluted, "I have been brought here, please make your decision." Hearing this, all the ministers were immediately confused. Emperor Yan Wen looked at Wu Yong and said coldly: "Who are you? Why did you come to Dayan? Tell the truth!" Wu Yong struggled to get up from the ground and stared at Emperor Yan Wen coldly: "I am Shuoli Khan Zhang.The spy, Wu Yong, is responsible for collecting spy information on Dayan."Haha, you bunch of stupid pigs, your doom is coming.""Shori Khan is about to lead 300,000 cavalry, together with Dongyu's 300,000 troops, to carve up Dayan, hahaha..." After hearing this, everyone's expressions suddenly changed, and the entire hall became noisy."What? Beidi and Dongyu have joined forces?" "Impossible, this is absolutely impossible. Dongyu has just signed an alliance with me, Dayan, how dare they backstab me, Dayan." "How dare you, who are you, to talk nonsense here?" "Tell me, who ordered you to do it?" "..." All the ministers suddenly became angry and scolded Wu Yong.At this moment, many of them believed that this was a play by the emperor, a play directed and performed by himself in order to prevent peace talks.Dongyu and Beidi have just signed a non-aggression pact. Before the prime minister who signed the pact returned to Dayan, Dongyu took action against Beidi?Is this possible?This is absolutely impossible!"Hahahaha...hahaha..." Wu Yong's hands and feet were shackled and handcuffed, and he was covered in blood. But when he heard the angry rebuke from the officials, he laughed like crazy and shed tears.The laughter almost instantly overwhelmed the condemnation in the hall."Bitch thief, why are you laughing?" someone couldn't help but yelled angrily."Why am I laughing? I'm laughing at you bunch of thieves!" Wu Yong tried his best to straighten up and stared at Emperor Yan Wen who was sitting on the throne: "How is it? Emperor, Your Majesty, do you feel sad? Do you feel ashamed?" "This is your minister, this is the pillar of your country!" "WenIf you don't think of cure, if you don't think of fighting, do you think Dayan can be saved?""Haha... you can only wait for my Beidi army to go south, and be slaughtered again..." Wu Yong suddenly waved his hand, and the iron chain in his hand was thrown away, frightening the ministers in the court to retreat in panic.Emperor Yanwen was expressionless, but he felt that his face had been swollen.All the ministers were so humiliated, and they suddenly became angry. Tang Jing pointed directly at Wu Yong and angrily shouted: "Look, you are also a Great Yan man, but you have become the dog of the Beidi people. You are a traitor. Do you have the nerve to shout here?" "I am not!" Wu Yong reprimanded angrily."I am not from Dayan. I was no longer from Dayan fifteen years ago." Wu Yong swept his hand across the audience and said with overwhelming hatred: "People from Dayan, haha, haha, these are the three words I hate the most in my life." "Do you know how we got here in Beidi these years?"Our women, our daughters, are humiliated by the Beidi people every day and every night.""Our children have just been born...yes, they have just seen the world for the first time. What awaits them is a red-hot soldering iron on them."There was a snort on his butt, and the smell of burnt meat spread under his breath, and then the child cried."For the rest of their lives, they have only one identity - slaves!""And all of this is because of you!""If it weren't for you, the so-called pillars of the court, who are greedy for power.How could countless other people like us, who are traitorous and fearful of death, suffer this fate!" "It's you who watch your people being kidnapped by Beidi and remain indifferent!" "Who is the thief?" "Hahahaha..." Wu Yong pointed at the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty and laughed.Tears mixed with blood fell down, so that his entire face alternated between green and white, extremely ferocious and terrifying.A group of civil servants felt their scalps go numb when they thought of the scene Wu Yong mentioned.But Di Cang and other generals clenched their fists, feeling their faces burning, and lowered their heads in shame.Emperor Yanwen looked at the frantic Wu Yong calmly, his heart felt like he was being stabbed by a knife."People from Great Yan? Hehe, bah!" "I am a traitor and I cannot forgive you, but I... am still ashamed of you!" "Great Yan will die if you have you! Hahaha..." Wu Yong Zhuangruo looked at Emperor Yan Wen crazily and said, "I have to say what I have to say.I have already said that your majesty, the emperor, wants to kill or behead him, just come!" "If I frown, I will be sorry for the thousands of compatriots who have been humiliated and died!" Emperor Yan Wen looked at Wu Yong standing in the main hall and was speechless for a moment.Treason should be punished.Treason should be beheaded.However, they were once loyal and patriotic... Who had ever loved them?Emperor Yanwen's eyes fell on the ministers in the palace, and he felt that they were particularly dazzling at this time.Loyal to the king and patriotic!Oh, I don’t know the sufferings of the people, and I don’t understand what the people want. They are just slogans!"Ningchuan, take him down!" Emperor Yanwen did not give the order to kill him.
title_en: Chapter 40 Your Majesty, you have no joke!
